title: A step the supervisor rejects goes back to its worker with the task, the supervisor's feedback and the rejected output set apart; the reworked output the supervisor approves is the step's
notes: Python: tests/test_supervisor.py TestSupervisedSequential::test_rework_on_rejection_then_approve, TestParseVerdict::test_plain_json. orchestration/strategies/supervisor/supervised.py _run_supervised_sequential, prompts.py _compose_rework, _normalize_verdict. The rejection's next_task is not read; each attempt is a task run of its own.
